description: The suite rows of one production script, a standard table search: {items, more}, each item keyed by script|suite, its label the row with the suite's filename and its status: "needs running" while it is flagged (never ran, or the script or suite changed since), "still red" once every test of it was tested since and one failed, "green" once every one passed. Only that script's rows, each suite once; the words narrow among them, '' for all. With no script, every suite, each once, its script '' and its key |suite: "needs running" if any of its rows is flagged, else "still red" if any is red, else "green".
